Using human herpes simplex type 1 virus (HSV-1) as a control to validate the functionality of our approaches, we demonstrated that neither endogenous nor overexpressed SAMHD restricted seasonal influenza A virus (IAV), human metapneumovirus (HMPV) and human parainfluenza virus type 3 (hPIV3) replication in either cell type. However, overexpression of SAMHD1 inhibited highly pathogenic avian influenza virus (HPAI) A(H5N1) in human macrophage-like cells. HSV-1 infects a wide range of cell types, including epithelial cells, keratinocytes, astrocytes, neurons and immune cells, yet most studies published to date have investigated the role of SAMHD1 in restricting HSV-1 replication in monocytes and macrophages. In Chapter 4, we focussed on assessment of SAMHD1 expression and its role in restricting HSV-1 replication in different cell types relevant to HSV-1 pathogenesis, including keratinocytes, neurons and astrocytes. We report that endogenous SAMHD1 did not restrict HSV-1 replication in any of the neuron, astrocyte or keratinocyte cell models tested, whereas restriction was observed in differentiated THP-1 macrophages. In contrast, inducible overexpression of SAMHD1 in neuronal, but not in keratinocyte cell lines, resulted in HSV-1 restriction, with variable results observed following overexpression in an astrocytic cell line. We also used human small molecule neural precursor cells (smNPCs), derived from human pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs) and differentiated into neurons or astrocytes, to confirm that endogenous SAMHD1 did not restrict HSV-1 replication in either cell type. Together, these results indicate that the capacity of both endogenous and overexpressed SAMHD1 to restrict HSV-1 replication is cell-type dependent. We extended our studies of human SAMHD1 and herpesviruses to investigate the ability of bovine SAMHD1 to restrict replication of human and bovine herpesviruses (Chapter 5). We used an inducible overexpression system to express bovine SAMHD1 and, for comparison, human SAMHD1 in bovine epithelial- and macrophage-like cells, enabling assessment of their ability to restrict bovine herpesvirus type 1 (BHV-1) replication. We demonstrate that inducible expression of either bovine or human SAMHD1 restricted the replication of BHV-1, as well as HSV-1. Restriction of BHV-1 by bovine SAMHD1 correlated with the inhibition of viral genomic replication and late viral gene expression. Furthermore, by introducing mutations known to impact the nuclear localisation, dNTPase activity or antiviral activity against lentiviruses, we show that only dNTPase activity was required for restriction of BHV-1 by bovine SAMHD1. In Chapter 6, we report the ability of MARCHF8 to restrict HSV-1 replication in macrophage- or epithelial-like cells. While it is widely established that MARCHF8 can restrict replication of several RNA viruses, this represents the first report of its ability to act against a DNA virus. For many RNA viruses, MARCHF8-mediated restriction has been associated with downregulation of viral envelope glycoproteins from the cell surface, thereby limiting their subsequent incorporation into nascent virions. However, while MARCHF8 expression did not affect virus entry, translocation of viral genome to the nucleus and immediate early (IE) gene expression, it did inhibit HSV-1 genomic replication, and therefore subsequent late viral gene expression and release of infectious virions. MARCHF8-mediated restriction of HSV-1 occurred independent of other cellular factors known to impact genomic replication of HSV-1, namely SAMHD1 and CD81, and could also proceed efficiently in cells expressing a functional cGAS-STING pathway. To our knowledge, these studies are the first to demonstrate MARCHF8-mediated restriction of a human DNA virus. Moreover, inhibition of HSV-1 genomic replication represents a novel mechanism of MARCHF8-mediated virus restriction that is distinct to its reported antiviral activity against RNA viruses. Overall, our studies indicate that SAMHD1 and MARCHF8 represent broad-spectrum host restriction factors with the ability to act across different classes of viruses with distinct viral genomes, likely via mechanisms distinct to those previously described. Furthermore, we demonstrate the potential of bovine SAMHD1 to restrict replication of BHV-1, a bovine herpesvirus associated with significant economic impact in the cattle industry. Targeting host restriction factors such as SAMHD1 and MARCHF8 represents a promising approach for the development of novel host-directed antiviral therapies.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 由于地方性感染、季节性流行和新出现的流行病,人类致病病毒仍然是全球公共卫生的持续威胁。宿主 限制因子构成先天 抗病毒药物 免疫的关键组成部分,可以在复制周期的多个阶段抑制多种 DNA 和 RNA 病毒。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该论文使用与病毒 发病机制 相关的人和牛细胞模型研究了两个 宿主 限制因子 SAMHD1 和 MARCHF8。研究重点是巨噬细胞样细胞、上皮细胞、神经元细胞、星形细胞和角质细胞细胞类型中的呼吸道 RNA 病毒、疱疹病毒和 1 型牛疱疹病毒 (BHV-1)。
analysis_zh.methods: 使用诱导过表达系统在相关细胞系中表达人和牛 SAMHD1,从而能够评估 抗病毒药物 针对甲型流感病毒 (IAV)、人偏肺病毒 (HMPV)、人副流感病毒 3 型 (hPIV3)、单纯疱疹病毒 1 型 (HSV-1) 和 BHV-1 的活性。功能测定检查了病毒基因组复制、晚期基因表达和限制机制。
analysis_zh.main_results: 内源性 SAMHD1 不会限制巨噬细胞样或上皮细胞中的季节性 IAV、HMPV 或 hPIV3 复制,但过表达会抑制巨噬细胞样细胞中的 高致病性禽流感 A(H5N1)。内源性 SAMHD1 仅在分化的 THP-1 巨噬细胞中限制 HSV-1 复制,而过表达则限制神经元中的 HSV-1,但不限制角化细胞或星形细胞系中的 HSV-1。人和牛 SAMHD1 都限制 BHV-1 复制,限制需要 dNTPase 活性。MARCHF8 通过抑制基因组复制和晚期基因表达来限制 HSV-1 复制,不依赖于 SAMHD1、CD81 和 cGAS-STING 途径。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现表明,SAMHD1 和 MARCHF8 通过与之前描述的机制不同的机制,在不同的病毒类别中充当广谱 宿主 限制因子。该研究报告了 MARCHF8 介导的 DNA 病毒限制的第一个证据,并鉴定了 SAMHD1 的细胞类型依赖性 抗病毒药物 活性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 结果凸显了针对 SAMHD1 和 MARCHF8 的 宿主 导向的 抗病毒药物 策略对抗多种病毒感染的潜力。他们还表明,牛 SAMHD1 可以为 BHV-1 的控制措施提供信息,BHV-1 是一种对牛具有重大经济影响的病原体。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据仅限于体外细胞模型,并未涉及体内功效或临床相关性。由于依赖过度表达系统且缺乏动物模型验证,证据强度中等。

title: Genome-wide association study reveals putative genetic determinants of longitudinal immune responses to avian influenza and Newcastle disease in chickens
abstract: Abstract Background Avian Influenza virus (AIV) and Newcastle disease virus (NDV) are highly contagious immunosuppressive pathogens that cause high mortality rates and economic losses in the global poultry industry. Although vaccination to enhance the host antibody response remains the main control strategy, the genetic basis of this variation is poorly understood. In this study, we used a genome-wide association study (GWAS) to investigate the genetic architecture of the longitudinal antibody responses to AIV (subtypes H5, H7, and H9) and NDV in chickens. Results To identify the genomic regions and candidate genes associated with the longitudinal antibody response to AIV and NDV after immunization, we conducted a GWAS using 1,359,927 SNP markers in an advanced intercross line (AIL) of the F19 resource population. We found moderate heritability for both the traits. Based on these associations, we identified the genomic regions and candidate genes for both traits. Association analysis revealed two significant SNPs located on chromosome 3, rs316474025 near NFKBIE and SLC35B2 [rs316474025], and rs312870707 near ATG5 gene, that are associated with viral antibody titers against AIV subtypes H5 and H7, respectively. Additionally, one variant on chromosome 27, rs318005864 near DDK12 and RPL19 genes, was strongly linked to the antibody response associated with NDV at mid-phase (40 days post-immunization). Furthermore, another variant, rs737164663, near FRMD5 and GLCE genes, was strongly linked to the antibody titer associated with both AIV subtype H9 and NDV in the late phase (60 days post-immunization). Genes located in these regions may be responsible for the immune response in chickens. Before implementation in breeding programs, the efficacy and long-term persistence of selecting these antibody response traits should be validated in larger independent cohorts. Conclusions We confirmed the presence of genetic variability and identified SNPs significantly associated with antibody titer traits in F19 chickens. These findings highlight genomic regions contributing to variation in antibody responses and provide valuable information for improving antibody-related traits through selective breeding programs.

analysis.methods: The GWAS analyzed 1,359,927 SNP markers to identify genomic regions and candidate genes associated with longitudinal antibody responses to AIV and NDV after immunization.
analysis.main_results: Moderate heritability was observed for antibody response traits. analysis.summary_en: This abstract-only study used a genome-wide association study (GWAS) in an advanced intercross line (AIL) of F19 chickens to investigate genetic determinants of longitudinal antibody responses to avian influenza virus (AIV) subtypes H5, H7, and H9 and Newcastle disease virus (NDV). Moderate heritability was observed for antibody response traits, and two significant SNPs on chromosome 3 (rs316474025 near NFKBIE and SLC35B2 for AIV H5, and rs312870707 near ATG5 for AIV H7) and one variant on chromosome 27 (rs318005864 near DDK12 and RPL19) linked to NDV antibody response at 40 days post-immunization were identified. The authors concluded that these genomic regions contribute to variation in antibody responses and provide targets for selective breeding programs to improve vaccine-induced immunity in poultry. However, the evidence is limited to an abstract-only report and requires validation in larger independent cohorts before practical implementation.

Association analysis revealed two significant SNPs located on chromosome 3, rs316474025 near NFKBIE and SLC35B2 [rs316474025], and rs312870707 near ATG5 gene, that are associated with viral antibody titers against AIV subtypes H5 and H7, respectively. Additionally, one variant on chromosome 27, rs318005864 near DDK12 and RPL19 genes, was strongly linked to the antibody response associated with NDV at mid-phase (40 days post-immunization). Furthermore, another variant, rs737164663, near FRMD5 and GLCE genes, was strongly linked to the antibody titer associated with both AIV subtype H9 and NDV in the late phase (60 days post-immunization). Genes located in these regions may be responsible for the immune response in chickens. Before implementation in breeding programs, the efficacy and long-term persistence of selecting these antibody response traits should be validated in larger independent cohorts. Conclusions We confirmed the presence of genetic variability and identified SNPs significantly associated with antibody titer traits in F19 chickens. These findings highlight genomic regions contributing to variation in antibody responses and provide valuable information for improving antibody-related traits through selective breeding programs.

title: Rapid Detection of N9 Subtype Avian Influenza Viruses Using an NA-Targeting Lateral Flow Immunoassay
abstract: The emergence of highly pathogenic avian influenza viruses (AIVs) poses significant threats to global public health and the poultry economy. Rapid detection methods targeting the hemagglutinin (HA) protein have become increasingly unreliable due to ongoing antigenic drift and genetic mutations. In this study, we screened two monoclonal antibodies (mAbs) against the highly conserved neuraminidase (NA) protein, which were characterized by high affinity and specificity for the N9 subtype. Using the paired mAbs 12A2 and 12F12, an NA-targeting lateral flow immunoassay (NA-LFIA) was developed for the rapid detection of N9 subtype AIVs. The NA-LFIA demonstrated exceptional specificity, exhibiting no cross-reactivity with the N1, N2, or N6 subtypes. The limits of detection (LODs) were established at 103.3 TCID50/0.1 mL for the virus and 98 ng/mL for the recombinant NA protein. The test strips exhibited excellent reproductivity for detecting the NA antigen, with intra-assay and inter-assay variations of 5.32% and 6.05%, respectively. Stability testing confirmed a six-month shelf life without any loss of sensitivity. These finds indicate that the NA-LFIA is a robust, rapid point-of-care testing (POCT) tool for the early detection of N9 subtype AIV infection.

title: Assessment of Humoral Immunogenicity of ChAdOx1 H5 HA Influenza Vaccine for Dairy Cattle
abstract: Background/objectives: The emergence of highly pathogenic avian influenza A (H5N1) virus infections in dairy cattle in the United States revealed a novel mammalian host and a potential transmission pathway involving raw milk and dairy production systems. Sustained circulation of H5N1 in dairy herds is of concern because ongoing viral adaptation in mammals may increase the risk of efficient mammalian transmission and subsequent zoonotic spread. In response to this emerging threat, we developed a chimpanzee adenovirus (ChAd)-vectored vaccine expressing the haemagglutinin 5 antigen (H5HA) from the dairy cattle isolate A/dairy cattle/Texas. Methods: Lactating dairy cows were vaccinated by either intramuscular (N = 3) or intranasal administration (N = 3). H5HA clade 2.3.4.4b antibodies in cow’s milk and sera were evaluated by ELISA. Hemagglutination and neutralisation capacity were also evaluated. Results: IgG and IgA H5HA-specific antibodies were detected in serum and milk from parenterally vaccinated animals, demonstrating the induction of a systemic immune response. The neutralising antibody responses elicited were only detected in serum of cows vaccinated via the intramuscular route. Conclusions: These preliminary findings support the feasibility of ChAd-vectored vaccination as a strategy to induce humoral immunity in cattle against emerging H5N1 influenza A viruses. Cross-reactive antibody responses against both A/dairy cattle/Texas/24-008749_001/2024 and A/Ibis/Egypt/RLQP-229S/2022 support the capacity of the vaccine to recognise antigenically related H5N1 clade 2.3.4.4b viruses circulating in mammalian and avian reservoirs. Further studies of vaccine efficacy and the immunological mechanism of protection should now be undertaken with the aim of reducing viral transmission and milk-associated shedding in dairy herds.

analysis.summary_en: This study assessed the humoral immunogenicity of a chimpanzee adenovirus-vectored vaccine expressing H5HA from an H5N1 dairy cattle isolate in lactating dairy cows. Six animals received either intramuscular or intranasal vaccination, and humoral responses were measured in serum and milk using ELISA, hemagglutination, and neutralisation assays. IgG and IgA H5HA-specific antibodies were detected in serum and milk after parenteral vaccination, while neutralising antibodies were restricted to serum following intramuscular administration. The vaccine elicited cross-reactive antibodies against antigenically related H5N1 clade 2.3.4.4b viruses. The authors conclude that ChAd-vectored vaccination may induce humoral immunity in cattle against H5N1, supporting further studies to evaluate efficacy and mechanisms of protection to reduce transmission and milk-associated shedding.

abstract_zh: 背景/目标:美国奶牛中 高致病性禽流感 A (H5N1) 病毒感染的出现揭示了一种新型哺乳动物 宿主 以及涉及原料奶和乳制品生产系统的潜在 传播 途径。H5N1 在奶牛群中的持续传播令人担忧,因为哺乳动物中持续的病毒适应可能会增加高效哺乳动物 传播 和随后的人畜共患传播的风险。为了应对这一新出现的威胁,我们开发了一种黑猩猩腺病毒 (ChAd) 载体 疫苗,表达来自奶牛分离株 A/德克萨斯州奶牛的血凝素 5 抗原 (H5HA)。方法:泌乳奶牛通过肌肉注射(N = 3)或鼻内注射(N = 3)进行疫苗接种。通过 ELISA 评估牛奶和血清中的 H5HA 进化枝 2.3.4.4b 抗体。还评估了血凝和中和能力。结果:在肠外接种疫苗的动物的血清和乳汁中检测到 IgG 和 IgA H5HA 特异性抗体,证明了系统性 免疫应答 的诱导。所引发的中和抗体反应仅在通过肌内途径接种疫苗的奶牛的血清中检测到。结论:这些初步研究结果支持 ChAd 载体 疫苗接种 作为诱导牛针对新出现的 H5N1 甲型流感病毒的体液免疫策略的可行性。针对 A/奶牛/德克萨斯/24-008749_001/2024 和 A/Ibis/埃及/RLQP-229S/2022 的交叉反应抗体反应支持 疫苗 识别在哺乳动物和鸟类 储存宿主 中传播的抗原相关 H5N1 分支 2.3.4.4b 病毒的能力。现在应该对 疫苗 功效和免疫保护机制进行进一步研究,以减少奶牛群中的病毒 传播 和与牛奶相关的脱落。

title: Immunogenicity and Protective Efficacy of a Serum-Free Suspension MDCK Cell Culture-Based Inactivated H3N8 Avian Influenza Vaccine Compared with an Egg-Based Counterpart in Chickens
abstract: H3N8 subtype avian influenza virus (AIV) circulates in poultry with occasional zoonotic potential and vaccines are crucial for preventing and controlling avian influenza.Here, two inactivated vaccines were prepared against the H3N8 AIV with GD1102 as vaccine strain: an embryonated chicken egg-based vaccine (E-vac) and a serum-free suspension MDCK cell-based vaccine (C-vac).The efficacy of both vaccines was evaluated in specific pathogen-free chickens.All vaccinated groups and the challenge control were intranasally challenged with 10 6 EID50 of GD1102 at 14 days post-vaccination (dpv) while the negative control group received no challenge.HI antibody titers, viral shedding, tissue viral loads, and pathological lesions were systematically assessed.Both vaccines elicited robust humoral immune responses at 7 dpv and the C-vac group had significantly higher HI titers than the E-vac group (p 6 log2).Compared with the control group, both vaccines effectively reduced viral shedding and lessened histopathological lesions.These findings suggest that C-vac elicits a rapid antibody response and confers effective protection.Therefore, C-vac can be considered a promising new platform for H3N8 avian influenza vaccines.

analysis.research_question_and_background: H3N8 avian influenza virus circulates in poultry with occasional zoonotic potential, creating a need for effective vaccines. The study aimed to compare the immunogenicity and protective efficacy of a serum-free suspension MDCK cell culture-based inactivated H3N8 vaccine with an egg-based counterpart in chickens.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study evaluated two inactivated H3N8 avian influenza vaccines in specific pathogen-free chickens: an embryonated chicken egg-based vaccine (E-vac) and a serum-free suspension MDCK cell-based vaccine (C-vac). Vaccinated groups and a challenge control were intranasally challenged with 10^6 EID50 of the GD1102 strain at 14 days post-vaccination, while a negative control group received no challenge.
analysis.methods: Both vaccines were prepared using the GD1102 H3N8 strain. Humoral immune responses were assessed via hemagglutination inhibition (HI) antibody titers at 7 days post-vaccination. Protection was evaluated by measuring viral shedding, tissue viral loads, and histopathological lesions after challenge.
analysis.main_results: Both vaccines elicited robust humoral immune responses at 7 days post-vaccination, with the C-vac group showing significantly higher HI titers than the E-vac group (p < 0.05). Compared with the control group, both vaccines effectively reduced viral shedding and lessened histopathological lesions.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that the C-vac platform elicits a rapid antibody response and confers effective protection against H3N8 avian influenza in chickens. They concluded that C-vac represents a promising new vaccine platform for H3N8 avian influenza.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that serum-free suspension MDCK cell-based inactivated vaccines may offer advantages over traditional egg-based vaccines for H3N8 avian influenza control in poultry. This platform could inform future vaccine development and deployment strategies for avian influenza prevention.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study was conducted in specific pathogen-free chickens and did not assess zoonotic transmission risk or long-term immunity. The evidence strength is moderate due to the limited scope of the animal model and absence of human-relevant endpoints.

analysis.summary_en: This study compared a serum-free suspension MDCK cell culture-based inactivated H3N8 avian influenza vaccine (C-vac) with an egg-based counterpart (E-vac) in specific pathogen-free chickens. Both vaccines induced robust humoral responses by 7 days post-vaccination, with C-vac showing significantly higher hemagglutination inhibition titers. Upon challenge with the GD1102 strain, both vaccines reduced viral shedding and histopathological lesions compared to controls. The authors conclude that C-vac is a promising new platform for H3N8 avian influenza vaccines. While the findings support the immunogenicity and protective efficacy of C-vac in poultry, the study's evidence strength is moderate due to its animal-only model and lack of human-relevant endpoints.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: H3N8 禽流感 病毒在家禽中传播,偶尔具有人畜共患病的可能性,因此需要有效的 疫苗。该研究旨在比较基于无血清悬浮 MDCK 细胞培养的灭活 H3N8 疫苗 与基于鸡蛋的对应物在鸡中的免疫原性和保护功效。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究评估了特定无病原体鸡中的两种灭活 H3N8 禽流感 疫苗:一种基于含胚鸡蛋的 疫苗 (E-vac) 和一种基于无血清悬浮 MDCK 细胞的 疫苗 (C-vac)。在 疫苗接种 后 14 天,接种组和攻击对照用 10^6 EID50 的 GD1102 菌株鼻内攻击,而阴性对照组不接受攻击。
elements_zh.methods: 两种 疫苗 均使用 GD1102 H3N8 菌株制备。在 疫苗接种 后 7 天通过血凝抑制 (HI) 抗体滴度评估体液 免疫应答。通过测量攻击后的病毒脱落、组织病毒载量和组织病理学病变来评估保护作用。
elements_zh.main_results: 两种 疫苗 在 疫苗接种 后 7 天均引发强劲的体液 免疫应答,其中 C-vac 组显示出显着高于 E-vac 组的 HI 滴度 (p < 0.05)。与对照组相比,疫苗 均有效减少病毒脱落并减轻组织病理学病变。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,C-vac 平台可引发快速抗体反应,并为鸡提供针对 H3N8 禽流感 的有效保护。他们得出的结论是,C-vac 代表了 H3N8 禽流感 的一个有前途的新 疫苗 平台。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,基于无血清悬浮 MDCK 细胞的灭活 疫苗 可能比传统的基于鸡蛋的 疫苗 在家禽中控制 H3N8 疫苗 具有优势。该平台可以为未来的 疫苗 开发和 禽流感 预防部署策略提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是在无特定病原体的鸡中进行的,没有评估人畜共患 传播 风险或长期免疫力。由于动物模型范围有限且缺乏与人类相关的终点,证据强度中等。

analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究评估了特定无病原体鸡中的两种灭活 H3N8 禽流感 疫苗:一种基于含胚鸡蛋的 疫苗 (E-vac) 和一种基于无血清悬浮 MDCK 细胞的 疫苗 (C-vac)。在 疫苗接种 后 14 天,接种组和攻击对照用 10^6 EID50 的 GD1102 菌株鼻内攻击,而阴性对照组不接受攻击。
analysis_zh.methods: 两种 疫苗 均使用 GD1102 H3N8 菌株制备。在 疫苗接种 后 7 天通过血凝抑制 (HI) 抗体滴度评估体液 免疫应答。通过测量攻击后的病毒脱落、组织病毒载量和组织病理学病变来评估保护作用。
analysis_zh.main_results: 两种 疫苗 在 疫苗接种 后 7 天均引发强劲的体液 免疫应答,其中 C-vac 组显示出显着高于 E-vac 组的 HI 滴度 (p < 0.05)。与对照组相比,疫苗 均有效减少病毒脱落并减轻组织病理学病变。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,C-vac 平台可引发快速抗体反应,并为鸡提供针对 H3N8 禽流感 的有效保护。他们得出的结论是,C-vac 代表了 H3N8 禽流感 的一个有前途的新 疫苗 平台。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,基于无血清悬浮 MDCK 细胞的灭活 疫苗 可能比传统的基于鸡蛋的 疫苗 在家禽中控制 H3N8 疫苗 具有优势。该平台可以为未来的 疫苗 开发和 禽流感 预防部署策略提供信息。

title: Understanding moral trade-offs in pandemic response: A discrete choice experiment on avian influenza policies
abstract: Pandemic preparedness requires navigating trade-offs between health, economic, and social impacts; choices that often involve moral tensions. This study investigates how the Dutch public evaluates such trade-offs in the context of a potential outbreak of highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI). Using a discrete choice experiment (DCE) administered to a representative sample of 1,045 respondents from the LISS panel, we examined preferences across six policy outcomes: mortality, lasting physical and mental injuries, postponed healthcare, social restrictions, and one-off tax payments. A latent class logit model identified four distinct preference profiles, revealing substantial heterogeneity in moral and economic reasoning. Two classes exhibited taboo trade-off aversion (TTOA) when values such as life or human dignity were traded against monetary costs. Respondents displaying TTOA emphasized solidarity and governmental responsibility, while cost-sensitive groups prioritized economic efficiency. These findings highlight that public acceptance of pandemic policies depends not only on effectiveness and cost but also on perceived moral legitimacy. Accounting for TTOA in economic evaluation can improve the ethical considerations and societal acceptability of future pandemic preparedness strategies.

analysis.summary_en: This study explores how the Dutch public evaluates moral trade-offs in pandemic response policies related to avian influenza. Using a discrete choice experiment with 1,045 respondents, the research identifies varying preferences across six policy outcomes, including mortality, injuries, healthcare delays, social restrictions, and tax payments. The analysis reveals four distinct preference profiles, highlighting substantial differences in moral and economic reasoning. Two groups showed aversion to trading values like life or human dignity for monetary costs, emphasizing solidarity and governmental responsibility, while others prioritized economic efficiency. The findings suggest that public acceptance of pandemic policies depends on perceived moral legitimacy, not just effectiveness and cost. The study's results underscore the importance of incorporating moral considerations into economic evaluations for improved societal acceptability of future pandemic preparedness strategies. However, the study is limited to examining preferences through a survey method, which may not fully capture real-world decision-making processes.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究调查了荷兰公众如何在 高致病性禽流感 (HPAI) 的潜在 暴发 背景下评估此类权衡。
elements_zh.methods: 通过对 LISS 小组中 1,045 名受访者的代表性样本进行离散选择实验 (DCE),我们检查了六种政策结果的偏好:死亡率、持久的身体和精神伤害、推迟医疗保健、社会限制和一次性纳税。
elements_zh.main_results: 潜在类别逻辑模型确定了四种不同的偏好概况,揭示了道德和经济推理中的巨大异质性。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 当生命或人类尊严等价值与金钱成本进行交易时,两个阶层表现出禁忌权衡厌恶(TTOA)。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 显示 TTOA 的受访者强调团结和政府责任,而对成本敏感的群体则优先考虑经济效率。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 这些发现强调,公众对流行病政策的接受程度不仅取决于有效性和成本,还取决于感知的道德合法性。

title: Generation of Nasal Cell-Derived Human Alveolar Organoids and Organoid-Macrophage Assembloids for in Vitro Lung Modeling.
abstract: We established robust protocols to generate physiological and functional alveolar organoids (nsoAlvO) from readily accessible and expandable nasal cell-derived organoids, and alveolar macrophages (monoAM) from peripheral blood monocytes. Through co-culture of nsoAlvO and monoAM, we generated organoid-macrophage assembloids, in which both components exhibited enhanced maturation. Comprehensive analyses, including immunostaining, functional assays, and single-cell RNA sequencing, demonstrated that the nsoAlvO and monoAM phenotypically and functionally resemble their native counterparts and engage in dynamic and extensive epithelial-macrophage communications. SSEA-1+ club cells were identified as the primary alveolar progenitor cells for nsoAlvO. Influenza virus infection in nsoAlvO revealed differential replicative fitness of H5N1 and H1N1 viruses, which recapitulate their authentic tropism in vivo. Notably, the addition of monoAM reduced H5N1 and H1N1 infection in nsoAlvO, suggesting a protective effect of alveolar macrophages against virus dissemination. These human alveolar organoids and organoid-macrophage assembloids provide universally accessible and physiologically relevant in vitro lung models for biomedical research and translational medicine.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addressed the need for physiologically relevant human lung models to study respiratory infections and host-pathogen interactions, highlighting limitations of existing in vitro systems for avian influenza research.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The research generated nasal cell-derived human alveolar organoids and alveolar macrophages from peripheral blood monocytes, then co-cultured them to create organoid-macrophage assembloids for in vitro modeling.
analysis.methods: The authors used immunostaining, functional assays, and single-cell RNA sequencing to validate that the organoids and macrophages phenotypically and functionally resembled native lung tissues and demonstrated epithelial-macrophage communications.
analysis.main_results: SSEA-1+ club cells were identified as the primary alveolar progenitor cells for nasal cell-derived alveolar organoids, and influenza virus infection experiments showed differential replicative fitness between H5N1 and H1N1 viruses that matched their authentic in vivo tropism.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The addition of alveolar macrophages to the organoids reduced infection by both H5N1 and H1N1 viruses, suggesting a protective role of macrophages against viral dissemination, and the models provided universally accessible in vitro systems for translational research.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These human alveolar organoids and assembloids offer physiologically relevant platforms for studying avian influenza pathogenesis, host responses, and evaluating antiviral strategies or vaccine candidates.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is limited to in vitro modeling and does not include clinical or epidemiological data, which constrains the generalizability of findings to human infections and reduces the strength of evidence to moderate.

analysis.summary_en: This study developed nasal cell-derived human alveolar organoids and alveolar macrophages from peripheral blood monocytes, then co-cultured them into organoid-macrophage assembloids that exhibited enhanced maturation and dynamic epithelial-macrophage interactions. Notably, the addition of alveolar macrophages reduced infection by both H5N1 and H1N1 viruses, suggesting a protective effect against viral dissemination. The authors propose these models as universally accessible and physiologically relevant in vitro platforms for biomedical research and translational medicine.

title: Detection of circovirus and herpesvirus co-infection in suddenly dead
abstract: This article investigates the causes of the sudden death of six common ravens (Corvus corax). All six birds were found on the same day in central Poland. The ravens were necropsied, and samples were collected for bacteriological, histopathological, and toxicological examinations. The presence of genetic material from common viral and some bacterial pathogens was examined using molecular methods. The ravens were found to be in good nutritional condition. Two birds had enlarged spleens with petechiae on their surface. Histopathological examination revealed multifocal hemorrhages and inflammatory infiltrates composed of mononuclear cells in the liver, and intranuclear inclusion bodies in hepatocytes. In the kidneys, inflammation, hemorrhages, parenchymal degeneration, and necrosis of the renal tubular epithelium were detected. Mild lymphocytic-plasmacytic inflammation was found in the intestines. Molecular tests were performed for circoviruses, herpesviruses, flaviviruses, adenoviruses, polyomavirus, avian bornavirus, avian paramyxovirus-1, rotavirus, avian reovirus, avian influenza viruses, Chlamydia spp., Salmonella spp., Clostridium spp., botulin toxins (A-E). Only PCR tests for circoviruses and herpesviruses yielded positive results. Toxicological tests were performed for the presence of organophosphate pesticides, rodenticides, coccidiostats, mycotoxins, and fungicides. Low and trace concentrations of brodifacoum (an anticoagulant rodenticide) and pentobarbital (a barbiturate) were detected. The remaining results were negative. analysis.summary_en: This case report investigated the sudden death of six common ravens in central Poland through comprehensive necropsy, histopathological, toxicological, and molecular analyses. Histopathological findings included multifocal hemorrhages, inflammatory infiltrates in the liver, intranuclear inclusion bodies in hepatocytes, renal inflammation, degeneration, and necrosis, alongside mild intestinal inflammation. Molecular testing identified circovirus and herpesvirus co-infection, with toxicological analysis detecting low concentrations of brodifacoum and pentobarbital. The authors suspected raven herpesvirus as the primary cause of death, reported for the first time in this species, though other factors such as poisoning or unknown pathogens could not be ruled out. The study underscores the importance of targeted surveillance for herpesvirus and circovirus in corvids for wildlife health and potential zoonotic risk assessment.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究通过调查潜在的病毒和毒性原因解决了六只普通乌鸦(Corvus corax)的突然死亡问题,因为尽管鸟类营养状况良好,但潜在的病因仍不清楚。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 同一天,在波兰中部发现六只死亡乌鸦,并对其进行了尸检,并收集样本进行细菌学、组织病理学、毒理学和分子检查,以鉴定病原体和毒素。

elements_zh.main_results: 组织病理学检查显示多灶性出血、肝脏炎症浸润、肝细胞核内包涵体、肾脏炎症、出血、实质变性、肾小管上皮坏死以及肠道轻度淋巴细胞浆细胞炎症。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者怀疑乌鸦疱疹病毒是乌鸦疱疹病毒的主要原因,这是首次在该物种中报道,可能与圆环病毒有关,但不能排除中毒或未知病毒等其他因素。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调需要针对鸦科动物的疱疹病毒和圆环病毒制定针对性的 监测 和诊断方案,以便为野生动物健康管理和潜在的人畜共患病风险评估提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到样本量小、缺乏对照鸟类、毒理学筛查不完整以及依赖分子检测而没有病毒分离的限制,因此评估的置信度较低。

title: The complexity of protecting poultry from HPAIV: Findings from a case-control study in Sweden.
abstract: High pathogenicity avian influenza (HPAI) has caused severe disruptions to poultry production worldwide and in Sweden in the last decade. During 2020 and 2021, 18 outbreaks were confirmed in poultry due to viral introduction from wild birds. The aim of the study was to investigate farm-level risk factors for HPAI in Swedish poultry, to guide prevention measures. A case-control study based on 15 cases from 2020 and 2021 and 33 controls, representing four poultry categories and three counties in southern Sweden was conducted. Data were collected through interviews with farmers/ farmworkers and on-farm observations using a questionnaire and Biocheck.UGentTM. Predictor variables were selected based on a hypothesised causal diagram and included in a case-control model using stability selection based on three regularisation models. In addition, a cross-sectional analysis was done based on poultry registry data, and six years of outbreak data. The case-control results showed an association between HPAI outbreaks and presence of waterfowl near the poultry farms. A higher number of birds per farm was positively associated with outbreaks in both parts of the study. Poultry category was associated with HPAI status where turkeys had higher risk and broilers lower risk of outbreaks in the cross-sectional study. The results didn't show a significant association between biosecurity score or other biosecurity covariates, but trends were identified that may deserve further research.

analysis.research_question_and_background: High pathogenicity avian influenza (HPAI) has caused severe disruptions to poultry production in Sweden and globally over the last decade, creating a need to identify farm-level risk factors to guide prevention measures.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A case-control study was conducted in southern Sweden, including 15 HPAI outbreak farms from 2020–2021 and 33 control farms across four poultry categories and three counties.
analysis.methods: Data were collected via farmer/farmworker interviews and on-farm observations using a questionnaire and the Biocheck.UGentTM tool, with predictor variables selected from a hypothesised causal diagram and analysed using stability selection based on three regularisation models.
analysis.main_results: The case-control analysis identified an association between HPAI outbreaks and the presence of waterfowl near poultry farms, while the cross-sectional study found that turkey farms had higher outbreak risk and broiler farms had lower risk.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study highlights waterfowl proximity as a key risk factor for HPAI outbreaks in Swedish poultry, with poultry category (turkeys vs. broilers) also influencing risk, suggesting targeted biosecurity measures may be needed.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings can inform targeted surveillance and biosecurity interventions in Swedish poultry farms, particularly in regions with high waterfowl activity or turkey production.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study did not find significant associations with biosecurity scores or other covariates, and trends identified require further research, limiting the strength of evidence for actionable conclusions.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated farm-level risk factors for highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) outbreaks in Swedish poultry during 2020–2021 using a case-control design comparing 15 outbreak farms to 33 controls across four poultry categories and three counties. Data were collected through farmer interviews and on-farm observations using a structured questionnaire and the Biocheck.UGentTM tool, with risk factors analysed via stability selection models. The main findings showed that proximity to waterfowl and poultry category (higher risk in turkeys, lower in broilers) were associated with HPAI outbreaks. While the study did not identify significant associations with biosecurity scores, it suggests that targeted surveillance and biosecurity measures in high-risk settings, particularly near waterfowl habitats or turkey farms, may help mitigate future outbreaks.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 过去十年中,高致病性 禽流感 (HPAI) 对瑞典和全球的家禽生产造成了严重破坏,因此需要确定农场层面的风险因素来指导预防措施。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在瑞典南部进行了一项病例对照研究,包括 2020 年至 2021 年期间的 15 个 HPAI 暴发 农场和横跨四个家禽类别和三个县的 33 个对照农场。
elements_zh.methods: 使用问卷和 Biocheck.UGentTM 工具通过农民/农场工人访谈和农场观察收集数据,从假设的因果图中选择预测变量,并使用基于三个正则化模型的稳定性选择进行分析。
elements_zh.main_results: 病例对照分析确定了 HPAI 暴发 与家禽养殖场附近水禽的存在之间存在关联,而横断面研究发现火鸡养殖场的 暴发 风险较高,而肉鸡养殖场的风险较低。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究强调,水禽接近是瑞典家禽中 HPAI 暴发 的一个关键风险因素,家禽类别(火鸡与肉鸡)也会影响风险,这表明可能需要有针对性的生物安全措施。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为瑞典家禽养殖场的针对性 监测 和生物安全干预措施提供信息,特别是在水禽活动或火鸡生产较高的地区。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究没有发现与生物安全评分或其他协变量的显着关联,并且确定的趋势需要进一步研究,限制了可操作结论的证据强度。

abstract_zh: 过去十年,高致病性 禽流感 (HPAI) 对全世界和瑞典的家禽生产造成了严重破坏。2020 年和 2021 年期间,由于 野生鸟类 的病毒引入,在家禽中确认了 18 个 暴发。该研究的目的是调查瑞典家禽农场层面的高致病性禽流感风险因素,以指导预防措施。一项病例对照研究基于 2020 年和 2021 年的 15 个病例和 33 个对照,代表瑞典南部的四个家禽类别和三个县。数据通过对农民/农场工人的访谈以及使用问卷和 Biocheck.UGentTM 进行的农场观察来收集。根据假设的因果图选择预测变量,并将其纳入使用基于三个正则化模型的稳定性选择的病例对照模型中。此外,还根据家禽登记数据和六年的 暴发 数据进行了横断面分析。病例对照结果显示 HPAI 暴发 与家禽养殖场附近水禽的存在存在关联。在研究的两个部分中,每个农场的鸟类数量较多与 暴发 呈正相关。家禽类别与 HPAI 状态相关,在横断面研究中,火鸡感染 暴发 的风险较高,肉鸡感染 暴发 的风险较低。结果并未显示生物安全评分或其他生物安全协变量之间存在显着关联,但确定了可能值得进一步研究的趋势。

title: Advances in the Development of a Universal Influenza Vaccine
abstract: Influenza remains a persistent global health threat, accounting for an estimated one billion infections and 350,000–600,000 deaths worldwide annually. Beyond substantial mortality and morbidity, influenza imposes major socio-economic costs through healthcare utilisation and productivity losses, amounting to tens of billions of dollars each year. Current seasonal vaccination strategies are constrained by rapid antigenic evolution, which necessitates frequent vaccine reformulation and contributes to suboptimal vaccine efficacy across seasons. These drawbacks highlight the need for a universal influenza vaccine (UIV) that protects against all seasonal and potential pandemic influenza strains via a single dose. This review evaluates the feasibility of a UIV as an alternative to a seasonal influenza vaccine (SIV) by consolidating evidence from current UIV candidates in preclinical and clinical development across a diverse range of platforms and target epitopes. Preclinical studies and clinical trials have demonstrated the safety and tolerability of multiple candidates, as well as their ability to elicit broadly cross-reactive immune responses. However, several challenges remain regarding the long-term efficacy of these vaccines. In particular, pre-existing host immunity can shape subsequent vaccine responses, with immune imprinting introducing biases toward previously encountered influenza strains, potentially reducing vaccine effectiveness. In addition, the genetic plasticity of influenza viruses, driven by ongoing mutations and genetic reassortment, raises concerns about the ability of a single vaccine formulation to maintain broad and durable protection. Overall, several UIV candidates have shown promising early results. Although ecological and immunological barriers remain, a UIV could become a viable alternative to, or eventual replacement, for SIVs.

title: Development of a Visual Rapid Assay for Novel Goose Astrovirus Detection Based on RT-MIRA -PfAgo
abstract: Goose astrovirus genotype 2 (GAstV-2) is an important pathogen associated with gosling gout, and rapid detection is useful for early diagnosis and field surveillance. In this study, a visual assay for GAstV-2 detection was developed by combining one-step reverse transcription multienzyme isothermal rapid amplification (MIRA) with the nucleic acid cleavage activity of Pyrococcus furiosus Argonaute (PfAgo). MIRA primers and specific guide DNAs were designed based on a conserved region of the GAstV-2 ORF1b gene, and the PfAgo reaction conditions were optimized. The optimal reaction contained 1.0 μM gDNA, 0.6 μM PfAgo, and 1.0 mM MnCl2. Using recombinant pUC57-ORF1b plasmid DNA as the template, the lowest detectable plasmid concentration under the tested conditions was 1.0 × 100 copies/μL. In the specificity assay, only GAstV-2 produced a positive signal, with no cross-reaction observed with GAstV-1, Tembusu virus, H9-subtype avian influenza virus, goose circovirus, fowl adenovirus serotype 4, or goose parvovirus. The assay was further tested with 23 clinical samples suspected of GAstV-2 infection. In a preliminary evaluation of 23 clinical samples, the RT-MIRA-PfAgo results were concordant with those obtained by conventional RT-PCR and RT-qPCR. Overall, the RT-MIRA-PfAgo assay provided sensitive and specific GAstV detection within a short time, without requiring programmed thermal cycling or an expensive real-time PCR instrument for routine endpoint detection. This method may be useful for GAstV-2 detection in basic laboratories and field settings.

title: Newton Divided Difference Optimization for Fingerprint-Based Neural Virtual Screening against Avian Influenza A/H9N2
abstract: Avian influenza A/H9N2 poses persistent zoonotic and veterinary threats, yet efficient computational tools for antiviral compound prioritization remain underdeveloped, particularly with respect to optimizer behavior in high-dimensional neural screening. This study proposes Newton Divided Difference (NDD) optimization, a lightweight positive diagonal curvature-aware training strategy, as a novel optimizer for fingerprint-based neural virtual screening against avian influenza A/H9N2, with the objective of evaluating its performance across aligned molecular fingerprint representations and chemically structured validation protocols. An aligned benchmark of 1,459 molecules consisting of 615 candidate active compounds and 844 decoys was represented by EState (79 features), PubChem (881 features), and Klekota–Roth (4,860 features) fingerprints, sharing identical molecule identities, labels, and split assignments. A fixed multilayer perceptron (MLP) classifier was trained with NDD and seven baseline optimizers under stratified, scaffold-key, and similarity-cluster split protocols across five repeated seeds. NDD achieved the highest descriptive ROC-AUC (Receiver Operating Characteriztic – Area Under the Curve) and PR-AUC (Precision-Recall Area Under the Curve) on Klekota–Roth fingerprints under scaffold-key and similarity-cluster protocols, and remained competitive under the stratified split with ROC-AUC of 0.9872. Architecture-sensitivity tests confirmed stable NDD performance across multiple network configurations, with ROC-AUC values ranging from 0.9876 to 0.9890. Compared with Hessian-free optimization, NDD reduced per-run runtime from approximately 50–54 seconds to approximately 8 seconds on Klekota–Roth under the same CPU-only configuration while achieving comparable ranking performance. The novelty of this work lies in the first systematic assessment of NDD for H9N2 neural virtual screening, demonstrating that positive diagonal curvature-aware scaling provides a practical, stable, and computationally efficient optimization alternative in sparse high-dimensional ligand-based screening settings, although external validation and prospective experimental confirmation remain necessary before practical antiviral prioritization.

This study proposes Newton Divided Difference (NDD) optimization, a lightweight positive diagonal curvature-aware training strategy, as a novel optimizer for fingerprint-based neural virtual screening against avian influenza A/H9N2, with the objective of evaluating its performance across aligned molecular fingerprint representations and chemically structured validation protocols. An aligned benchmark of 1,459 molecules consisting of 615 candidate active compounds and 844 decoys was represented by EState (79 features), PubChem (881 features), and Klekota–Roth (4,860 features) fingerprints, sharing identical molecule identities, labels, and split assignments. A fixed multilayer perceptron (MLP) classifier was trained with NDD and seven baseline optimizers under stratified, scaffold-key, and similarity-cluster split protocols across five repeated seeds. NDD achieved the highest descriptive ROC-AUC (Receiver Operating Characteriztic – Area Under the Curve) and PR-AUC (Precision-Recall Area Under the Curve) on Klekota–Roth fingerprints under scaffold-key and similarity-cluster protocols, and remained competitive under the stratified split with ROC-AUC of 0.9872. Architecture-sensitivity tests confirmed stable NDD performance across multiple network configurations, with ROC-AUC values ranging from 0.9876 to 0.9890. Compared with Hessian-free optimization, NDD reduced per-run runtime from approximately 50–54 seconds to approximately 8 seconds on Klekota–Roth under the same CPU-only configuration while achieving comparable ranking performance. The novelty of this work lies in the first systematic assessment of NDD for H9N2 neural virtual screening, demonstrating that positive diagonal curvature-aware scaling provides a practical, stable, and computationally efficient optimization alternative in sparse high-dimensional ligand-based screening settings, although external validation and prospective experimental confirmation remain necessary before practical antiviral prioritization.

analysis.summary_en: This study introduces Newton Divided Difference (NDD) optimization as a novel method for fingerprint-based neural virtual screening against avian influenza A/H9N2. The research highlights the need for efficient computational tools to prioritize antiviral compounds, especially in high-dimensional screening settings. The study evaluates NDD's performance across different molecular fingerprint representations and split protocols, demonstrating its effectiveness with high ROC-AUC and PR-AUC values. NDD is shown to be stable and computationally efficient, with performance consistent across various network configurations. However, the findings lack external validation and experimental confirmation, which limits their practical application. The results suggest that NDD could be a valuable tool for improving antiviral compound prioritization in avian influenza research, though further studies are needed to confirm its utility in real-world scenarios.

abstract_zh: 禽流感 A/H9N2 造成持续的人畜共患病和兽医威胁,但用于 抗病毒药物 化合物优先级排序的有效计算工具仍然不发达,特别是在高维神经筛选中的​​优化器行为方面。本研究提出了牛顿除差(NDD)优化,这是一种轻量级正对角曲率感知训练策略,作为针对 禽流感 A/H9N2 的基于指纹的神经虚拟筛选的新型优化器,目的是评估其在对齐的分子指纹表示和化学结构验证协议中的性能。由 615 种候选活性化合物和 844 种诱饵组成的 1,459 个分子的对齐基准由 EState(79 个特征)、PubChem(881 个特征)和 Klekota–Roth(4,860 个特征)指纹代表,共享相同的分子身份、标签和分割分配。固定多层感知器 (MLP) 分类器使用 NDD 和七个基线优化器在分层、支架键和相似性聚类分割协议下跨五个重复种子进行训练。NDD 在支架密钥和相似性聚类协议下的 Klekota–Roth 指纹上实现了最高的描述性 ROC-AUC(接收者操作特征 - 曲线下面积)和 PR-AUC(曲线下精确召回面积),并且在分层分割下保持竞争力,ROC-AUC 为 0.9872。架构敏感性测试证实了跨多种网络配置的稳定 NDD 性能,ROC-AUC 值范围为 0.9876 至 0.9890。与无 Hessian 优化相比,在相同的仅 CPU 配置下,NDD 将 Klekota-Roth 上的每次运行时间从大约 50-54 秒减少到大约 8 秒,同时实现了相当的排名性能。这项工作的新颖性在于首次系统评估 H9N2 神经虚拟筛选的 NDD,证明正对角线曲率感知缩放在稀疏高维配体筛选设置中提供了实用、稳定且计算高效的优化替代方案,尽管在实际 抗病毒药物 优先级排序之前仍然需要外部验证和前瞻性实验确认。
